sb.name: Adranach
sb.damage_immunities: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from non-magical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
sb.languages: understands the languages spoken by its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Arcane Leak
traits.desc: When the adranach is reduced to half its hit point maximum (85 hit points), its mithral mask cracks and its arcane form begins to waver, creating a field of unstable magic around it. Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the adranach or enters that area for the first time on a turn takes 10 (3d6) radiant damage. Additionally, if a creature casts a spell within this area, it must make a DC 14 ability check using its spellcasting ability. On a failure, the spell backfires, consuming the spell slot and dealing 3 (1d6) force damage to the caster for each level of the spell slot that was consumed.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The adranach is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The adranach has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The adranach's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.desc: The adranach counts as one size larger when determining its carrying capacity and the weight it can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Variant: Adranach Customization
traits.desc:
Adranachs are constructs personalized to their creators. One of the traits that make a spellwright candidate attractive to the League of Miracles is an interest in invention, and spellwrights are encouraged to customize any adranach they create. Below are some optional features with which spellwrights have outfitted their creations. Most adranachs have one extra feature, and most master adranachs have three.

- **Advanced Tracking (Recharges after a Long Rest).** When a creature fails its saving throw against the adranach's Force Bolts, the adranach can mark that creature for the next 24 hours. The adranach knows the direction to a creature's location as long as they are on the same plane. If the creature is moving, the adranach knows the direction of this movement.
- **Arcane Bond.** The adranach's creator can communicate with it telepathically while both are within 1 mile of each other. As an action, the creator can see through the adranach's eyes and hear what it hears until the start of the creator's next turn, gaining the benefits of any special senses the adranach has. During this time, the creator is deafened and blinded with regard to their own senses.
- **Slipstream.** The adranach can cast [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|invisibility]] on itself at will. While it is invisible, its speed is doubled.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The adranach makes two attacks with its claws.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, one target, reach 5 ft. Hit: 32 (4d12 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Force Bolts (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The adranach targets up to four creatures it can see within 60 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) force damage.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The firetamer is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Druidcraft|druidcraft]], [[Tools/Spells/Mending|mending]], [[Tools/Spells/Produce Flame|produce flame]] (2d8)
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Cure Wounds|cure wounds]], [[Tools/Spells/Faerie Fire|faerie fire]], [[Tools/Spells/Jump|jump]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Flame Blade|flame blade]], [[Tools/Spells/Heat Metal|heat metal]], [[Tools/Spells/Lesser Restoration|lesser restoration]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Daylight|daylight]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Protection From Energy|protection from energy]]
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Freedom Of Movement|freedom of movement]], [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Fire|wall of fire]]
- **5th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Conjure Elemental|conjure elemental]]

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Flamecharm (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: The firetamer can cast the [[Tools/Spells/Dominate Monster|dominate monster]] spell (save DC 15) on a fire elemental or other elemental fire creature. If the creature has 150 or more hit points, it has advantage on the saving throw.

bonus_actions.name: Flameform (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
bonus_actions.desc: The firetamer can transform into a fire elemental. Its game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the elemental, but the firetamer retains its alignment, personality, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, and all of its skill and saving throw proficiencies. While in this form, the firetamer can't cast spells. When the firetamer is reduced to 0 hit points, falls unconscious, or dies in this form, it reverts to its humanoid form. It can remain in flameform for up to 5 hours or until it reverts to its humanoid form as a bonus action.

bonus_actions.name: Druidic Recovery
bonus_actions.desc: If the firetamer is in fire elemental form using Flameform, it can expend a spell slot to regain 1d8 hit points per level of the spell slot expended.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If the skydancer is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the skydancer instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The skydancer doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Skysail
traits.desc: The skydancer flies with a special Ashari magic item called a skysail. While the skysail's wings are extended, the skydancer can glide through the air at a speed of 60 feet, but must descend by at least 10 feet at the end of its turn and can't gain altitude.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The skydancer is a 3rd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Guidance|guidance]], [[Tools/Spells/Shillelagh|shillelagh]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Entangle|entangle]], [[Tools/Spells/Fog Cloud|fog cloud]], [[Tools/Spells/Jump|jump]]
- **2nd level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Gust Of Wind|gust of wind]], [[Tools/Spells/Pass Without Trace|pass without trace]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The skydancer makes two skysail staff attacks.

actions.name: Skysail Staff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the skydancer makes this attack while flying, the target must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Fly (1/Day)
actions.desc: The skydancer uses its skysail to cast [[Tools/Spells/Fly|fly]] on itself for up to 1 minute (no concentration required).

reactions.name: Slow Fall
reactions.desc: When the skydancer takes falling damage, it can reduce the damage by half.

sb.name: Ashari Stoneguard
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from non-magical attacks, when using skin-to-stone

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The stoneguard is a 3rd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Druidcraft|druidcraft]], [[Tools/Spells/Resistance|resistance]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Goodberry|goodberry]], [[Tools/Spells/Speak With Animals|speak with animals]], [[Tools/Spells/Thunderwave|thunderwave]]
- **2nd level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|hold person]], [[Tools/Spells/Spike Growth|spike growth]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The stoneguard makes three granite maul attacks.

actions.name: Granite Maul
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the attack hits, the stoneguard can also immediately cast [[Tools/Spells/Thunderwave|thunderwave]] as a bonus action. This casting uses a spell slot but requires no components.

reactions.name: Sentinel
reactions.desc: When a creature within 5 feet of the stoneguard attacks a target other than the stoneguard, the stoneguard can make one attack against that creature.

reactions.name: Skin to Stone
reactions.desc: When the stoneguard is attacked, it gains resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks until the end of the attacker's turn

traits.name: Healing Tides
traits.desc: Whenever the waverider casts a spell of 1st level or higher that affects a non-hostile creature, that creature regains 3 hit points (in addition to any healing the spell may provide).

traits.name: Marine Empathy
traits.desc: The waverider can speak with and understand aquatic plants and animals.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The waverider is a 7th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Druidcraft|druidcraft]], [[Tools/Spells/Poison Spray|poison spray]] (2d12), [[Tools/Spells/Resistance|resistance]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Create Or Destroy Water|create or destroy water]], [[Tools/Spells/Cure Wounds|cure wounds]], [[Tools/Spells/Healing Word|healing word]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Animal Messenger|animal messenger]], [[Tools/Spells/Lesser Restoration|lesser restoration]], [[Tools/Spells/Moonbeam|moonbeam]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Conjure Animals|conjure animals]] (aquatic beasts only), [[Tools/Spells/Water Breathing|water breathing]], [[Tools/Spells/Water Walk|water walk]]
- **4th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Control Water|control water]]

actions.name: Harpoon
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a Strength contest against the waverider or be pulled up to 20 feet toward the waverider. Attacks with this weapon made while underwater do not have disadvantage.

reactions.name: Fishform (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
reactions.desc: The waverider can transform into a hunter shark or a giant octopus. Its game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the chosen creature, but the waverider retains its alignment, personality, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. It also retains its skill proficiencies, in addition to gaining those of the creature it transforms into. When the waverider is reduced to 0 hit points, falls unconscious, or dies in this form, it reverts to its humanoid form. It can remain in fishform for up to 3 hours or until it reverts to its humanoid form as a bonus action.

sb.name: Black King
sb.damage_immunities: poison, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The Black King is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The Black King has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The Black King's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Black King makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Slow (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The Black King targets one or more creatures it can see within 10 feet of it. Each target must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic. On a failed save, a target can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the target can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. These effects last for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

sb.name: Blighted Sapling
sb.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 9

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: twice your druid level

traits.name: Proficiency Bonus
traits.desc: equals your bonus

traits.name: Blighted Resilience (10th level or higher)
traits.desc: The creature has immunity to necrotic and poison damage and to the poisoned condition.

traits.name: Toxic Demise (10th level or higher)
traits.desc:
When the creature is reduced to 0 hit points, it explodes in a burst of toxic mulch or fetid viscera. Each creature within 5 feet of the exploding creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or take necrotic damage based on the creature's challenge rating (see the table below). As an action, you can also cause a summoned creature to explode, immediately killing it.

- **Toxic Demise Damage.** (Creature CR / Damage) 1/4 or lower: 1d4 necrotic damage | 1/2: 1d6 necrotic damage | 1 or higher: A number of d8s of necrotic damage equal to the creature's challenge rating | No challenge rating: A number of d6s of necrotic damage equal to your proficiency bonus

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: When you reach 14th level in this class, the blighted sapling makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d4 + PB piercing damage.

traits.name: Charge
traits.desc: If the centaur moves at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a pike attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) piercing damage.

traits.name: Variant: Centaur Skeleton Customization
traits.desc:
Some centaur skeletons have the following additional feature at the GM's discretion.

- **Spirit Away.** The centaur skeleton and up to three creatures within 5 feet of it magically enter the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. An unwilling creature that succeeds on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw can resist this effect.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The centaur skeleton makes two attacks: one with its pike and one with its hooves, or two with its longbow.

actions.name: Pike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

sb.name: Champion of Ravens
sb.damage_resistances: radiant, necrotic, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.languages: Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Druidic, Elvish, Thieves' cant

traits.name: Assassinate
traits.desc: During his first turn, the Champion has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit the Champion scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

traits.name: Aura of Protection
traits.desc: While the Champion is conscious, he and friendly creatures within 10 feet of him have a +3 bonus to saving throws (included above).

traits.name: Eternal Champion
traits.desc: When the Champion is reduced to 0 hit points or dies, his body is destroyed but his spirit returns to the Raven Queen's side, and he gains a new body after 1d4 days.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If the Champion is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails.

traits.name: Fate-Touched (4/Day)
traits.desc: When the Champion makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, he can reroll the d20 and use either roll. Alternatively, when a creature the Champion can see makes an attack roll against him, or a saving throw against one of his spells or features, he can force that creature to reroll the attack or save and use the new roll.

traits.name: Shadow Smite (1/Turn)
traits.desc: The Champion deals an extra 49 (14d6) radiant or necrotic damage (his choice) when he hits a target with a weapon attack and he doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Unerring Sight
traits.desc: The Champion's ranged weapon attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover and have no range penalty.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: The Champion wears boots of haste and the Deathwalker's Ward, and wields Whisper.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The Champion's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (+10 to hit with spell attacks, save DC 18). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Bane|bane]], [[Tools/Spells/Bless|bless]], [[Tools/Spells/Druidcraft|druidcraft]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Greater Invisibility|greater invisibility]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Champion makes three attacks with Whisper.

actions.name: Whisper
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d4 + 8) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) psychic damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the Champion for 1 minute. On a ranged attack, the Champion can teleport with Whisper, appearing within 5 feet of the target on a hit, or in a random space within 30 feet of the target on a miss.

actions.name: Touch of Life and Death (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: The Champion touches a creature within 5 feet of him, and chooses to either heal or harm that creature, restoring 55 (10d10) hit points or dealing 55 (10d10) necrotic damage. If the creature is an unwilling target, it can avoid either effect with a successful DC 20 Dexterity saving throw.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning Action
bonus_actions.desc: The Champion takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

bonus_actions.name: Boots of Haste (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The Champion clicks his heels together, casting [[Tools/Spells/Haste|haste]] on himself. He doesn't suffer from lethargy when the spell ends.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.desc: The Champion halves the damage that he takes from an attack that hits him. He must be able to see the attacker.

sb.name: Cinderslag Elemental
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from non-magical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Searing Presence
traits.desc: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the elemental takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.

traits.name: Molten Form
traits.desc: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. In addition, the elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage and must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be restrained. A creature that starts its turn restrained in this way takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. It can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, freeing itself on a success.

traits.name: Water Susceptibility
traits.desc: For every 5 feet the elemental moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 cold damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The elemental makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

actions.name: Molten Gaze
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (6d6) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or have one nonmagical item of the elemental's choice that the target is carrying instantly melt or burn to cinders.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: The cutthroat deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the cutthroat that isn't incapacitated and the cutthroat doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The cutthroat makes two shortsword or dagger attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning Action
bonus_actions.desc: The cutthroat can take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.desc: The cutthroat halves the damage that it takes from an attack that hits it. The cutthroat must be able to see the attacker.

traits.name: Intimidating Presence
traits.desc: Whenever the enforcer hits a creature with a melee attack, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the enforcer until the end of the target's next turn. The enforcer and its allies have advantage on attack rolls against any creature frightened in this way. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the enforcer's Intimidating Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The enforcer makes three warhammer attacks.

actions.name: Warhammer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

bonus_actions.name: Second Wind (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
bonus_actions.desc: The enforcer regains 12 hit points

sb.name: Cobalt Golem
sb.damage_immunities: fire, lightning, poison, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
sb.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Conductive Body
traits.desc: Whenever the golem is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage. Instead, its weapon attacks deal an extra 11 (2d10) lightning damage until the end of its next turn. Also until the end of the golem's next turn, any creature that touches it or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 11 (2d10) lightning damage.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The golem makes two attacks: one with its slam and one with its sword, or it uses its Magnetic Pulse and then its Spinning Cleave.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Sword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (3d12 + 9) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spinning Cleave
actions.desc: The golem makes a sword attack against each creature within 10 feet of it.

actions.name: Magnetic Pulse (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The golem raises its arms and unleashes a magnetic pulse. All unattended metal objects within 30 feet of it are pulled to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the golem. Each creature wearing metal armor or made of metal within 30 feet of the golem must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pulled to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the golem, then fall prone.

traits.name: Sense Heat
traits.desc: The cold snap spirit can sense heat within 60 feet of it.

traits.name: Frozen Aura
traits.desc: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of a cold snap spirit takes 5 (1d10) cold damage.

traits.name: Jealous Spirit
traits.desc: If the spirit attacks a creature that is within 5 feet of another cold snap spirit, the attack deals an extra 10 (3d6) cold damage on a hit.

actions.name: Consume Warmth
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (6d6) cold damage, and the target's speed is halved until the end of the spirit's next turn.

actions.name: Subzero Wave (1/Day)
actions.desc: Each creature within 30 feet of the cold snap spirit must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

sb.name: Cyclops Stormcaller
sb.ac_class: chain mail, cloak of protection, ring of protection

traits.name: One-Eyed
traits.desc: The cyclops has disadvantage on any attack roll against a target more than 30 feet away.

traits.name: Storm Wings
traits.desc: While outdoors in stormy conditions, the cyclops has a flying speed of 60 feet.

traits.name: Supernatural Focus
traits.desc: The cyclops has advantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain concentration on spells, and cannot lose concentration because of turbulent weather.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The cyclops's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The cyclops can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Ray Of Frost|ray of frost]] (3d8), [[Tools/Spells/Water Walk|water walk]]
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Ice Storm|ice storm]], [[Tools/Spells/Sleet Storm|sleet storm]], [[Tools/Spells/Wind Wall|wind wall]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Control Weather|control weather]], [[Tools/Spells/Storm Of Vengeance|storm of vengeance]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The cyclops makes two ice claw attacks.

actions.name: Ice Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The spider makes two melee attacks: one with its bite and one with its stinger; or the spider can make one attack with its web spinner followed by a melee attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 27 (6d8) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't poisoned. If this poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Web Spinner
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 40 ft., one target. Hit: The target is pulled 40 feet toward the spider and is grappled (escape DC 14). The spider can grapple only one creature at a time in this way. As an action, the spider can cocoon a creature it has grappled in webbing, causing it to be restrained and ending the grappled condition.

reactions.name: Arterial Spray
reactions.desc: When the spider takes damage while below half its hit point maximum, it can spray poisonous blood in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 13 (3d8) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't poisoned. If this poison damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, the creature is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The spiderling can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.desc: The spiderling ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

sb.name: Diseased Grick
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.desc: The diseased grick has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The diseased grick's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12 +4 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Contagion|contagion]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The diseased grick makes one attack with its tentacles. If that attack hits, the diseased grick can make one beak attack against the same target.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

sb.name: Doty X
sb.languages: understands the languages that Tary speaks

traits.name: Arcane Surge (4/Day)
traits.desc: When Doty hits a target, Tary can channel magical energy to deal an extra 14 (4d6) force damage to the target as long as Tary is not incapacitated.

traits.name: Dedicated Servant
traits.desc: Doty has an additional 20 hit points, and has a +2 modifier to saving throws, ability checks using skill proficiencies, and attack rolls.

traits.name: Limited Vocabulary
traits.desc: Doty can say the following words in Common: "Tary," "Yes," "Correct," "Absolutely," "Soon," and "Handsome."

traits.name: Vigilant
traits.desc: Doty can't be surprised.

actions.name: Empowered Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) force damage.

actions.name: Repair (3/Day)
actions.desc: Doty regains 15 (2d8 + 6) hit points.

reactions.name: Deflect
reactions.desc: If a creature within 5 feet of Doty that he can see makes an attack against a creature other than Doty, he can impose disadvantage on the attack roll. The attacker then takes 6 (1d4 + 4) force damage.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.desc: The hydra has five heads. While it has more than one head, the hydra has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious. Whenever the hydra takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the hydra dies. At the end of its turn, it grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken fire damage since its last turn. The hydra regains 10 hit points for each head regrown in this way.

traits.name: Reactive Heads
traits.desc: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.desc: While the hydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hydra makes as many bite attacks as it has heads.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.desc: The roc has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Searing Presence
traits.desc: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the roc takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.desc: The roc sheds bright light in a 40-foot radius and dim light for an additional 40 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The roc makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (4d8 + 8) piercing damage and 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) slashing damage and 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Inferno (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The roc beats its wings, creating a swirling conflagration. Each creature within 30 feet of the roc must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) fire damage.

sb.name: Flaming Skeleton
sb.languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Heated Weapons
traits.desc: When the skeleton hits with a metal melee weapon, the weapon deals an extra 3 (1d6) fire damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Illumination
traits.desc: The skeleton sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage and 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Ignite
actions.desc: The skeleton flings itself at a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 12). On a failed save, the target also takes 3 (1d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns, even after the grapple ends. If the target or a creature within 5 feet of it uses an action to put out the flames, or if some other effect douses the flames (such as the target being submerged in water), the effect ends.

sb.name: Forge Guardian
sb.damage_immunities: fire, poison, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Fire Absorption
traits.desc: Whenever the guardian is subjected to fire damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the fire damage dealt.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The guardian is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The guardian has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The guardian's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The guardian makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Runeblade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until it deals damage to the guardian.

actions.name: Kick
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (2d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed up to 15 feet away from the guardian and knocked prone.

actions.name: Bladestorm (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The guardian makes a Runeblade attack against every creature within 15 feet of it. On a hit, a target is also pushed up to 15 feet away from the guardian and knocked prone.

legendary_actions.name: Runeblade
legendary_actions.desc: The guardian makes one Runeblade attack.

legendary_actions.name: Kick
legendary_actions.desc: The guardian makes one Kick attack.

legendary_actions.name: Trample (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The guardian moves up to 50 feet without triggering opportunity attacks, and can pass through other creature's spaces. Each creature whose space the guardian passes through must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 23 (2d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone. Any creature that shares the guardian's space when it stops this movement is pushed out of its space into the nearest unoccupied space.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

sb.name: Goat-Knight Steed
sb.languages: understands Dwarvish but can't speak it

traits.name: Shared Spells
traits.desc: Any spell the goat-knight casts with a range of self also targets the goat-knight steed

traits.name: Summoned Nature
traits.desc: When a goat-knight steed drops to 0 hit points, it disappears, leaving behind no physical form. The goat-knight can also dismiss the steed at any time as an action, causing it to disappear. In either case, the same steed is summoned when the goat-knight casts [[Tools/Spells/Find Steed|find steed]].

traits.name: Charge
traits.desc: If the goat-knight steed moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Sure-Footed
traits.desc: The goat-knight steed has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

actions.name: Ram
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

sb.name: Grog Strongjaw
sb.damage_resistances: cold, fire, lightning, thunder while enlarged; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing while raging
sb.languages: Common, Dwarvish, Giant, with limited reading and writing

traits.name: Brutal Critical
traits.desc: When Grog scores a critical hit, he rolls double weapon damage dice as usual, then rolls 3 additional weapon damage dice.

traits.name: Feral Instinct
traits.desc: Grog has advantage on initiative rolls.

traits.name: Melee Master
traits.desc: Grog can take a −5 penalty to any melee attack roll to gain a +10 bonus to the damage roll.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.desc: At the start of his turn, Grog can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against him have advantage until the start of his next turn.

traits.name: Relentless Rage
traits.desc: If Grog is reduced to 0 hit points while raging, he drops to 1 hit point instead if he succeeds on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Grog wears a belt of dwarvenkind. He wields the Bloodaxe (a +2 magic weapon), a dwarven thrower, and the Titanstone Knuckles.

traits.name: Spellbreaker
traits.desc: When Grog damages a creature that is concentrating on a spell, that creature has disadvantage on the saving throw to maintain its concentration. In addition, Grog has advantage on saving throws against spells cast by creatures within 5 feet of him.

traits.name: Toughness
traits.desc: Grog has an additional 40 hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Grog makes two attacks (three when raging) with his Bloodaxe, dwarven thrower, or Titanstone Knuckles.

actions.name: Bloodaxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (1d12 + 14) slashing damage and 3 (1d6) necrotic damage. If the target is reduced to 0 hit points, Grog gains 10 temporary hit points.

actions.name: Dwarven Thrower
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60, one target. Hit: 24 (2d8 + 15) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Titanstone Knuckles
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (1d4 + 12) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Enlarge (Recharges after a Long Rest)
actions.desc: Grog casts [[Tools/Spells/Enlarge/Reduce|enlarge/reduce]] on himself to grow in size for 10 minutes. While enlarged in this way, he has resistance to cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage.

bonus_actions.name: Rage (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
bonus_actions.desc: Grog enters a rage that lasts until he falls unconscious or chooses to end it (no action required). While raging, Grog gains the following benefits: • He has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. • He deals an extra 4 damage when he hits a target with a melee weapon attack (included in attacks) • He has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage • He can't be charmed or frightened • He can make an additional melee weapon attack (included in the Multiattack action) When Grog's rage ends, he gains one level of exhaustion.

reactions.name: Opportunist
reactions.desc: When a creature within 5 feet of Grog casts a spell or deals damage to him, Grog can make a melee weapon attack against that creature.

sb.name: Jourrael, the Caedogeist
sb.damage_resistances: acid, fire, lightning, cold, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: frightened, grappled, paralyzed, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: Jourrael can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. They take 5 (1d10) force damage if they end their turn inside an object.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: Jourrael deals an extra 35 (10d6) damage when they hit a target with a weapon attack and have advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Jourrael that isn't incapacitated and Jourrael doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Inevitable
traits.desc: If Jourrael is reduced to 0 hit points, they do not fall unconscious but becomes an incorporeal spirit for 24 hours. During this time, Jourrael can't return to their original form until they returns to full hit points. In this form, they are invisible, can't attack or interact with corporeal creatures or objects, and can't be targeted by spells. After 24 hours have passed, Jourrael regains 1 hit point and returns to their original form with four levels of exhaustion.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Jourrael's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Dancing Lights|dancing lights]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Darkness|darkness]], [[Tools/Spells/Faerie Fire|faerie fire]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Jourrael makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

actions.name: Spectral Blade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d6 + 7) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is also unconscious while poisoned in this way. The target wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

actions.name: Void Dagger
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d4 + 7) piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning Action
bonus_actions.desc: Jourrael can take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

bonus_actions.name: Mirrored Form (Recharges after a Short Rest)
bonus_actions.desc: Jourrael manifests three illusory duplicates that hover in her space. Each time a creature targets Jourrael with an attack, roll a d20 to see if it hits one of the duplicates. If there are three duplicates, a duplicate is targeted on a roll of 6 or higher. With two duplicates, a duplicate is targeted on a roll of 8 or higher. A single duplicate is targeted on a roll of 11 or higher. A duplicate's AC is 17, and it is destroyed if hit. Jourrael can hide the duplicates as a bonus action.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Jourrael adds 5 to her AC against one melee attack that would hit her. To do so, she must see the attacker

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Keyleth has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put her to sleep.

traits.name: Focused
traits.desc: Keyleth has advantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain concentration on spells.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Keyleth wears a circlet of wisdom (which increases her Wisdom score by 2), +2 leather armor, and a ring of protection with a +2 bonus. She wields the Spire of Conflux.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Keyleth is a 20th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 22, +14 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following druid spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Druidcraft|druidcraft]], [[Tools/Spells/Guidance|guidance]], [[Tools/Spells/Mending|mending]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Cure Wounds|cure wounds]], [[Tools/Spells/Faerie Fire|faerie fire]], [[Tools/Spells/Fog Cloud|fog cloud]], [[Tools/Spells/Healing Word|healing word]], [[Tools/Spells/Thunderwave|thunderwave]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Alter Self|alter self]] (at will), [[Tools/Spells/Flaming Sphere|flaming sphere]], [[Tools/Spells/Gust Of Wind|gust of wind]], [[Tools/Spells/Pass Without Trace|pass without trace]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Call Lightning|call lightning]], [[Tools/Spells/Wind Wall|wind wall]]
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Blight|blight]], [[Tools/Spells/Control Water|control water]], [[Tools/Spells/Grasping Vine|grasping vine]], [[Tools/Spells/Polymorph|polymorph]], [[Tools/Spells/Stone Shape|stone shape]]
- **5th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Conjure Elemental|conjure elemental]], [[Tools/Spells/Greater Restoration|greater restoration]], [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|scrying]], [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Stone|wall of stone]]
- **6th level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Heroes' Feast|heroes' feast]], [[Tools/Spells/Move Earth|move earth]], [[Tools/Spells/Transport Via Plants|transport via plants]]
- **7th level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Fire Storm|fire storm]], [[Tools/Spells/Plane Shift|plane shift]]
- **8th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Control Weather|control weather]]
- **9th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Foresight|foresight]], [[Tools/Spells/Shapechange|shapechange]]

actions.name: Shapechange
actions.desc: Keyleth casts [[Tools/Spells/Shapechange|shapechange]] to transform into a planetar, an adult bronze dragon, or another creature of CR 20 or lower that is not a construct or undead.

actions.name: Meteor (Earth Elemental Form Only)
actions.desc: When Keyleth falls at least 20 feet, she lands with meteoric force. Each creature within 20 feet of her must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet Keyleth fell. Keyleth still takes falling damage while in earth elemental form.

actions.name: Chain Lightning
actions.desc: Keyleth casts [[Tools/Spells/Chain Lightning|chain lightning]] (spell save DC 22) from the Spire of Conflux at a creature she can see within 150 feet of her.

bonus_actions.name: Wild Shape
bonus_actions.desc: Keyleth magically [[Tools/Spells/Polymorph|polymorphs]] into a beast or elemental of CR 6 or lower. Her game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the new form, but she retains her alignment, personality, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. She also retains all of her skill and saving throw proficiencies, in addition to gaining those of the new form. She assumes the new form's hit points and Hit Dice and returns to the number of hit points she had when she reverts to her normal form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by her new form (her choice). She reverts to her humanoid form as a bonus action, or when she falls unconscious. Her attacks in Wild Shape form are magical, and she can cast spells while transformed.

bonus_actions.name: Healing Word (4th Level)
bonus_actions.desc: Keyleth casts [[Tools/Spells/Healing Word|healing word]], restoring 16 (4d4 + 6) hit points to herself or another creature she can see within 60 feet of her.

traits.name: Aura of Protection
traits.desc: Whenever the goat-knight or a creature friendly to it within 10 feet of it makes a saving throw, that creature gains a +2 bonus (included in the goat-knight's saving throws above). The goat-knight must be conscious to grant and gain this bonus.

traits.name: Divine Health
traits.desc: The goat-knight is immune to disease.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.desc: The goat-knight has resistance to poison damage and advantage on saving throws against poison.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The goat-knight is a 6th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following paladin spells prepared:

- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Bless|bless]], [[Tools/Spells/Cure Wounds|cure wounds]], [[Tools/Spells/Protection From Evil And Good|protection from evil and good]], [[Tools/Spells/Sanctuary|sanctuary]], [[Tools/Spells/Shield Of Faith|shield of faith]]
- **2nd level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Branding Smite|branding smite]], [[Tools/Spells/Find Steed|find steed]] (Goat-Knight Steed only), [[Tools/Spells/Lesser Restoration|lesser restoration]], [[Tools/Spells/Zone Of Truth|zone of truth]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The goat-knight makes two warhammer attacks.

actions.name: Warhammer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

sb.name: Mage Hunter Golem
sb.damage_immunities: poison, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
sb.senses: darkvision 120 ft., truesight 30 ft., passive Perception 15
sb.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Antimagic Cone
traits.desc: The golem creates an area of antimagic, as in the [[Tools/Spells/Antimagic Field|antimagic field]] spell, in a 60-foot cone originating from it. At the start of each of its turns, the golem decides which way the cone faces and whether the cone is active.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Absorption
traits.desc: Whenever the golem is subjected to a damage-dealing spell of 4th level or lower, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the damage dealt.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The golem uses its Antimagic Jolt and makes two melee attacks, or it makes three melee attacks.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or have a magic collar placed upon its neck. While the target wears the collar, it is magically prevented from speaking and cannot cast any spell. A successful DC 25 Dexterity check using thieves' tools removes the collar.

actions.name: Antimagic Jolt
actions.desc: Each creature within the golem's Antimagic Cone that has the ability to cast a spell of 1st level or higher must make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

sb.name: Magma Landshark
sb.speed: 50 ft., burrow 50 ft., swim 50 ft. (lava only)
sb.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 120 ft., passive Perception 17

traits.name: Searing Presence
traits.desc: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the landshark takes 11 (2d10) fire damage.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.desc: The landshark's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet, with or without a running start.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.desc: The landshark sheds bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 45 (6d12 + 6) piercing damage, and 14 (4d6) fire damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the landshark. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the landshark, and it takes 42 (12d6) fire damage at the start of each of the landshark's turns. If the landshark takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the landshark must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the landshark. If the landshark dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Deadly Leap
actions.desc: If the landshark jumps at least 15 feet as part of its movement, it can then use this action to land on its feet in a space that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 18 Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice) or be knocked prone and take 27 (6d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) fire damage. On a successful save, the creature takes only half the damage, isn't knocked prone, and is pushed 5 feet out of the landshark's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice. If no unoccupied space is within range, the creature instead falls prone in the landshark's space.

actions.name: Lava Pool (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: If the landshark is on solid ground, it melts the area around it, creating a pool of lava in a 10-foot radius. Any creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn takes 44 (8d10) fire damage.

sb.name: Master Adranach
sb.damage_immunities: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from non-magical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
sb.languages: the languages spoken by its creator

traits.name: Arcane Leak
traits.desc: When the adranach is reduced to half its hit point maximum (145 hit points), its mithral mask cracks and its arcane form begins to waver, creating a field of unstable magic around it. Any creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the adranach or enters that area for the first time on a turn takes 21 (6d6) radiant damage. Additionally, if a creature casts a spell within this area, it must make a DC 18 ability check using its spellcasting ability. On a failure, the spell backfires, consuming the spell slot and dealing 7 (2d6) force damage to the caster for each level of the spell slot that was consumed.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The adranach is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The adranach has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The adranach's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Colossal Build
traits.desc: The adranach's carrying capacity is doubled, as is the weight it can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Slipstream
traits.desc: The adranach can cast [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|invisibility]] on itself at will. While it is invisible, its speed is doubled.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the adranach fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Variant: Adranach Customization
traits.desc:
Adranachs are constructs personalized to their creators. One of the traits that make a spellwright candidate attractive to the League of Miracles is an interest in invention, and spellwrights are encouraged to customize any adranach they create. Below are some optional features with which spellwrights have outfitted their creations. Most adranachs have one extra feature, and most master adranachs have three.

- **Advanced Tracking (Recharges after a Long Rest).** When a creature fails its saving throw against the adranach's Force Bolts, the adranach can mark that creature for the next 24 hours. The adranach knows the direction to a creature's location as long as they are on the same plane. If the creature is moving, the adranach knows the direction of this movement.
- **Arcane Bond.** The adranach's creator can communicate with it telepathically while both are within 1 mile of each other. As an action, the creator can see through the adranach's eyes and hear what it hears until the start of the creator's next turn, gaining the benefits of any special senses the adranach has. During this time, the creator is deafened and blinded with regard to their own senses.

When Scanlan uses this ability, he gains advantage on attack rolls with Mythcarver until the end of his turn.

bonus_actions.name: Healing Word (5th Level)
bonus_actions.desc: Scanlan casts [[Tools/Spells/Healing Word|healing word]], restoring 18 (5d4 + 6) hit points to himself or another creature he can see within 60 feet of him.

reactions.name: Cutting Words
reactions.desc: When a creature Scanlan can see within 60 feet of him makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a damage roll, he can expend a use of Bardic Inspiration to roll a d12 and subtract the number rolled from the creature's roll. The creature also has disadvantage on its next saving throw.

sb.name: Taryon Darrington
sb.speed: 40 ft., fly 50 ft. (with broom of flying)

traits.name: Alchemical Defense
traits.desc: Tary's experimental concoctions have granted him resistance to acid and poison damage, and immunity to the poisoned condition.

traits.name: Doty
traits.desc: Doty moves and acts on Tary's turn, and Tary can use a bonus action to command him to use the Dash, Dodge, Disengage, or Attack action. He can also command him to Attack as part of his Multitask action (see below). Doty can take only one action on each of Tary's turns.

traits.name: Focused
traits.desc: Tary has advantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain concentration on spells.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Tary wears a helm of brilliance, a robe of useful items, and a ring of the ram. He carries a rod of mercurial form, as well as a bag of holding, 1d4 + 4 beads of force, a broom of flying, and a chime of opening.

traits.name: Toughness
traits.desc: Tary has an additional 30 hit points.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Tary is a 15th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Mending|mending]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]], [[Tools/Spells/Ray Of Frost|ray of frost]] (3d8)
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Heroism|heroism]], [[Tools/Spells/Identify|identify]], [[Tools/Spells/Shield|shield]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Alter Self|alter self]], [[Tools/Spells/Branding Smite|branding smite]], [[Tools/Spells/See Invisibility|see invisibility]], [[Tools/Spells/Warding Bond|warding bond]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Fly|fly]], [[Tools/Spells/Haste|haste]], [[Tools/Spells/Magic Circle|magic circle]], [[Tools/Spells/Revivify|revivify]]
- **4th level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Banishment|banishment]], [[Tools/Spells/Fabricate|fabricate]], [[Tools/Spells/Fire Shield|fire shield]]

actions.name: Multitask
actions.desc: Tary makes two weapon attacks or casts a spell with a casting time of 1 action, and can also command Doty to use his Empowered Fist or Repair action.

actions.name: Mercurial Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bead of Force
actions.desc: Tary throws a bead of force up to 60 feet. Each creature within a 10-foot radius of where the bead landed must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 12 (5d4) force damage. A sphere of transparent force then encloses the area for 1 minute. A creature that fails the save and is completely within the area is trapped inside the sphere.

reactions.name: Brilliant Intellect
reactions.desc: When Tary or another creature he can see within 30 feet of him makes an ability check or a saving throw, he can use his reaction to add +4 to the roll.

sb.name: Trinket
sb.languages: understands Common but can't speak it

traits.name: Chosen Companion
traits.desc: Trinket has an additional 10 hit points, and has a +6 bonus to attack and damage rolls and to Wisdom (Perception) checks.

traits.name: Empowered Attacks
traits.desc: Trinket's attacks are treated as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to damage from nonmagical attacks.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: Trinket has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Raven's Slumber
traits.desc: If Trinket is reduced to 0 hit points and is within 100 feet of Vex, he is immediately drawn into the demiplane within Vex's raven's slumber and stabilized.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Trinket makes two attacks: one with his bite and one with his claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (1d8 + 10) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d6 + 10) slashing damage.

sb.name: Vex'ahlia
sb.ac_class: +2 Studded White Dragon Leather Armor of Cold Resistance, +2 ring of protection
sb.speed: 30 ft., fly 50 ft. (with broom of flying)
sb.languages: Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Elvish, Thieves' Cant, Undercommon

traits.name: Assassinate
traits.desc: During her first turn, Vex has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit Vex scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If Vex is subjected to an effect that allows her to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, she instead takes no damage if she succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if she fails.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Vex has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put her to sleep.

traits.name: Ranged Master
traits.desc: Vex's ranged weapon attacks have a +2 bonus to hit (included in attacks), and ignore half cover and three-quarters cover, and have no range penalty. Additionally, Vex can take a −5 penalty to any ranged attack roll to gain a +10 bonus to the damage roll.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: Vex deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Vex that isn't incapacitated and she doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Vex wears +2 Studded White Dragon Leather Armor of Cold Resistance and a ring of protection with a +2 bonus. She carries a broom of flying and a raven's slumber, and wields Fenthras.

traits.name: Trinket
traits.desc: Trinket moves and acts on Vex's turn, and Vex can use a bonus action to command him to take the Dash, Dodge, Disengage, or Attack action. She can also command him to Attack as part of her Multiattack action (see below). Trinket can take only one action on each of Vex's turns.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Vex is a 13th-level spellcaster. Her spell-casting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following ranger spells prepared:

- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Cure Wounds|cure wounds]], [[Tools/Spells/Hunter'S Mark|hunter's mark]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Pass Without Trace|pass without trace]], [[Tools/Spells/Protection From Poison|protection from poison]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Lightning Arrow|lightning arrow]], [[Tools/Spells/Nondetection|nondetection]]
- **4th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Freedom Of Movement|freedom of movement]], [[Tools/Spells/Grasping Vine|grasping vine]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Vex makes two ranged attacks, and can command Trinket to move up to his speed and use his Multiattack action.

actions.name: Fenthras
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, range 600 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (1d8 + 18) piercing damage and 3 (1d6) lightning damage, and Vex can use the following ability:

actions.name: Bramble Shot (2/Short Rest)
actions.desc: The attack deals an extra 18 (4d8) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be restrained. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning Action
bonus_actions.desc: Vex takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

bonus_actions.name: Hunter's Mark
bonus_actions.desc: Vex casts [[Tools/Spells/Hunter'S Mark|hunter's mark]] to mark a creature she can see within 90 feet of her. For 1 hour, Vex's weapon attacks deal an extra 1d6 damage to the marked creature, and she has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Survival) checks made to find it.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.desc: When an attacker that Vex can see hits her with an attack, she takes half damage from the attack.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: The serpentfolk can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The serpentfolk's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Animal Friendship|animal friendship]], [[Tools/Spells/Speak With Animals|speak with animals]] (snakes only)
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Sleep|sleep]], [[Tools/Spells/Suggestion|suggestion]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Pass Without Trace|pass without trace]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The serpentfolk makes two scimitar attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained, and the serpentfolk can't constrict another target.

sb.name: Vos'skyriss Serpentfolk Ghost
sb.damage_resistances: acid, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.desc: The ghost can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ghost makes two spear attacks.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If the ghost makes a ranged attack, its spear rematerializes in its hands after the attack is resolved.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.desc: The ghost enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

actions.name: Terrifying Hiss
actions.desc: The ghost emits an uncanny, rasping hiss. Each non-undead creature within 30 feet of the ghost that can hear it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this ghost's Terrifying Hiss for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the wraithroot tree remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.

traits.name: Wraith Shift
traits.desc: On its turn, the wraithroot tree can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. The tree does not provoke opportunity attacks while moving, and must finish its movement in a space unoccupied by any Large or larger objects or creatures. Any Medium or smaller creature in the tree's space when it finishes moving is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space of the creature's choice. Medium or smaller objects in the tree's space are pushed to the nearest unoccupied spaces of the tree's choice.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The wraithroot tree makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Wraithstorm (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The wraithroot tree pulls life energy from the area around it, leaving creatures temporarily frail. Each creature that is not a construct or undead within 30 feet of the tree must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or have its speed halved and gain vulnerability to bludgeoning damage until the end of the tree's next turn.

sb.name: Young Magma Landshark
sb.speed: 40 ft., burrow 40 ft., swim 40 ft. (lava only)
sb.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 120 ft., passive Perception 14

traits.name: Searing Presence
traits.desc: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the landshark takes 11 (2d10) fire damage.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.desc: The landshark's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet, with or without a running start.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.desc: The landshark sheds bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (4d12 + 5) piercing damage, and 14 (4d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Deadly Leap
actions.desc: If the landshark jumps at least 15 feet as part of its movement, it can then use this action to land on its feet in a space that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 16 Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice) or be knocked prone and take 19 (4d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage. On a successful save, the creature takes only half the damage, isn't knocked prone, and is pushed 5 feet out of the landshark's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice. If no unoccupied space is within range, the creature instead falls prone in the land-shark's space.
